Seris 0.1.0-beta.4 fixes Chinese input confirmation, model-picker alignment and macOS packaging.

### Changes

- Prevent Chinese/Japanese/Korean input-method candidate confirmation from submitting a message, including WebKit's composition-end-before-Enter ordering. A subsequent Enter still sends normally in both Chat and Markets Chat.
- Center the model-picker chevron with the model label and retain the icon when long names are truncated.

- Sign the complete macOS application bundle, including its resource seal, with an ad-hoc signature. Beta.2 only had a linker signature and could be reported as damaged after a browser download.
- Strip local symbols from the bundled Node runtime and native SDK, re-sign the optimized binaries, remove dependency source maps/type declarations, and archive duplicate dependency payloads as hardlinks. Runtime functionality and dependency licenses are retained.
- Verify the complete application signature, extracted production dependencies and native startup before publishing. Resolve the DMG by the current version so a cached older installer cannot be uploaded accidentally.
- Existing persistent strategies, model metadata, conversations and backtest results retain their locations.

### Validation

- Built-UI browser regressions cover candidate confirmation, a single subsequent send, and label/chevron layout with short and truncated names.

- 71 automated regressions, TypeScript checks and production dependency audit passed on macOS. Four Rust tests passed; two tests requiring real keychain writes remain opt-in.
- The extracted distribution passed native Longbridge loading, TypeScript strategy compilation, browser-library loading, PDF/Word/Excel/PowerPoint generation, strategy discovery, session creation and clean shutdown with an empty PATH.
- Native cold-cache startup, saved model configuration, keychain bridge after crash recovery and child-process cleanup passed.
- A browser-downloaded DMG copied through Finder passed full signature verification with its download quarantine intact. macOS displayed the expected unverified-app warning and provided the Open Anyway button, rather than the damaged-app warning.

### Installation and limits

- **macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon) only.** Drag Seris from the DMG to Applications.
- **Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.** On the first launch, macOS may report that Apple cannot verify Seris. Click Done, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** and approve this app. See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/102445).
- An upgrade can ask for keychain authorization to read an existing model credential. Complete the system prompt before testing the model connection.
- Strategies remain local backtests, with no live order execution. Automation and Portfolio are prototypes. Alerts run only while Seris is running, and market-data access depends on the provider and region.

This release includes the strategy persistence, backtest workspace, chat draft fixes and settings improvements from Beta.2.
